"""Unit tests verifying centralized grammar patterns and cleaners."""

from __future__ import annotations

from vihap.cleaners import exact_text_key
from vihap.grammar import (
    COMMERCIAL_CATEGORY_TOKENS,
    CONVENIENCE_CHAIN_PATTERN,
    EXPLICIT_GATE_PATTERN,
    HEALTHCARE_FACILITY_PREFIXES,
    HOUSE_NUMBER_IN_TEXT_RE,
    MILITARY_AND_DISTRICT_MASK_PATTERN,
    PREFIX_GATE_PATTERN,
    PREFIX_SUBUNIT_PATTERN,
    SPURIOUS_TRANSPORT_PATTERN,
)


def test_exact_text_key() -> None:
    assert exact_text_key("Bệnh Viện Bạch Mai - Cổng 1") == (
        "benh",
        "vien",
        "bach",
        "mai",
        "cong",
        "1",
    )
    assert exact_text_key("7-Eleven_Nguyễn Huệ") == ("7", "eleven", "nguyen", "hue")
    assert exact_text_key("") == ()
    assert exact_text_key(None) == ()


def test_centralized_gate_patterns() -> None:
    # Explicit gate pattern
    assert EXPLICIT_GATE_PATTERN.search("Cổng số 1")

    assert EXPLICIT_GATE_PATTERN.search("Gate #2")
    assert not EXPLICIT_GATE_PATTERN.search("Công trường Mê Linh")
